name: Eldr
tagline: The coordination layer for enterprise elder care.
positioning: Eldr unifies caregivers, clinicians, and families onto one governed care ledger — so large operators coordinate every case without the phone-tag.

hero.h1: Coordinate every care case across your entire network.
hero.sub: Eldr replaces the spreadsheet handoffs, faxed care plans, and 6pm phone-tag with one governed ledger connecting caregivers, clinicians, and families in real time.

features.title: Unified care ledger
features.description: Every assessment, medication change, and shift note lands on one immutable record — no more reconciling three systems before a care conference.

features.title: Caregiver dispatch
features.description: Route the right credentialed caregiver to each visit by proximity, skill, and continuity, then track arrival and completion without a single call.

features.title: Compliance guardrails
features.description: State-specific care-plan rules, HIPAA logging, and audit-ready exports enforced automatically across every region you operate.

features.title: Family transparency portal
features.description: Give adult children a controlled, live view of visits, incidents, and billing — cutting inbound status calls to your care line by the hundreds.

features.title: Utilization analytics
features.description: See margin, missed visits, and readmission risk per facility in one board, and forecast staffing before the gaps become incidents.

features.title: EHR & payer sync
features.description: Bi-directional connectors to Epic, PointClickCare, and major payers keep authorizations and claims aligned with delivered care.

testimonials.quote: Before Eldr our regional coordinators lived in email threads. Now every care event is timestamped on one ledger — we cut missed visits by 31% in the first two quarters.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: The audit-ready exports alone justified the deployment. Our last state survey took days instead of weeks because every care plan was already reconciled.
testimonials.name: Marcus Enriquez

testimonials.quote: Family call volume was drowning our intake team. The transparency portal moved most of that off the phones and our CSAT went up at the same time.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan
